description: A user procedure declared `Double` (mixed case) called as `DOUBLE` with too few arguments raises ol-not-enough-inputs whose params.callable is the definition's declared spelling `Double`, not the call site casing nor a lowercasing — case-insensitive identifiers can never make the call spelling the diagnostic identity (spec/error-model.md:254-259), and a mixed-case declaration is what distinguishes the declared-spelling rule from mere lowercasing (matching check-side issue #874). Issue #1005.
